notes.title: Patch Notes September 2025
notes.content:
v1.4.0
- Modifies the behaviour for fetching leaderboards and other playthroughs from the database to prevent hangs on starting game. 
- Backend infrastructure changes for improvements in efficiency and smaller data payloads

notes.title: Godmode Epochs sequel: Fango 1000
notes.content: [p]Data generated in the first thousand plays of [b][i]Godmode Epochs[/i][/b] is now discoverable in the cinematic universe of Fango 1000, a free text game where players compete for narrative control.[/p][p]The game is set in the fictional Italian village of Fango circa 1173, where a trove containing a thousand chronicles has suddenly appeared inside a monastery, each describing the training of a mysterious 'machine intelligence' from the future. [/p][p]Players join either Monks, Scholars or Fools and compete to tell the best story about what secrets the machine may hold. [/p][p]More info: [url="https://dmstfctn.net/related-matters/fango-1000/"]dmstfctn.net/related-matters/fango-1000/[/url][/p][p]Link to play: [url="https://fango1000.dmstfctn.net/"]fango1000.dmstfctn.net[/url][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183423/fd2c5106e070aec416eba3acded1a89dc5edbd3a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183423/d5b9a1283dfd71456c17ab230e36e211f5dab39e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183423/b2766f95023b40fe8b39e652b9a2319a3d952ea8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183423/f7a648554e2904e0957b1eb841c245fd1630ed27.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183423/8cf8d4dec928871a0be6b71caf230b3bd0a7f452.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: Speedrun Godmode Epochs!
notes.content:
Added a leaderboard - see the top times and race to get yourself on there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183423/5acd511a72b73028562b90d22e8f5e1fcacd0904.png[/img]

Main Updates:
-Added a top 10 training epoch leaderboard on the title screen
-Added a top 5 training epoch leaderboard on the end screen, including your final position displayed alongside the top 5
-Added animated arrows to the in-game UI leaderboard for feedback on real-time movement up and down the ranks
-Added clearer notification system animations
-You can also submit your run on https://www.speedrun.com/Godmode_Epochs


Other changes:
-Fixed the glitch where when exploring the memory the mouse unpegs from the cursor
-Optimisations for 80% speedier loading and database updates
-New title screen and visual updates to end screens
-The game no longer crashes when it's unmaximised
-Fixed some spelling mistakes

notes.title: June 28 Update Notes
notes.content:
UI modifications, mostly to the jailbreaks listing interface (with thanks to The FluffeyPanda for feedback on this)
- the jailbreaks panel now closes when you move your character 
- new tutorial screens to show other ways to close the panel
- new descriptions for jailbreaks
- clearer indication that there's a limit to the number of jailbreaks

Stage to stage balancing
- new movement speeds for later stages

Also some typo fixing and some visual tidying.
